# Day Links

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A support note within a Day Cluster capturing links or references relevant to that day.

## Scope note

Alongside DayActions within DayClusterSupport; used for reference material rather than actionable tasks.

## Broader

- [Day Cluster Support](../DayClusterSupport/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
